title: Server
description: The server Forager is a client of: where it fetches its configuration from, the access key it signs every request as, and the pin, the server's keys it verifies every answer under. The access key's secret lives outside this document: the command reads it from a file descriptor, else QORY_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET, else the file access-key-secret. Lives outside the checkout, beside the policy. Configuring a server makes the run fail closed: no run starts unless the discovery fetch returns a signed 200 and the server accepts the run's registration with a signed 200.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

url.description: The server's origin: scheme and host, with a port when there is one, and nothing after it. https, or http to a loopback address only. Forager fetches its configuration from /.well-known/qory-configuration under it.

access_key_id.description: The id of the access key every request is signed as, sent on every request in X-Qory-Access-Key-Id and signed as a line of it: ak_ and 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters, which the server assigns when the key enrols.

apiary_public_key.description: The pin: the server's Ed25519 public keys, a list so the key can rotate. Every answer of the server is verified under one of them, and Forager takes keys from this list alone. A run with a server and no pin is refused before the first request, apiary_public_key_missing.

public_key.description: A raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.
